baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction joins the sign, divine carrying, their descendants, the ship, and its loaded state.
baseline_models.mechanism: A dispersed human continuation is concentrated into a capacity-bearing vessel and moved intact; the preservation mechanism, not the vehicle alone, is the visible sign.

activation_trace.role: The visible-mark image frames the entire carrying event as an inspectable sign.
Literal lifting of people in a vessel supplies the transport operation.
Smallness and dispersal make posterity a numerous continuity gathered from scattered units.
The ship branch supplies the bounded carrier moving through water.
Filling and completing a vessel turns the descendants into a fully assumed load.

changed_reading.before: A bare report that descendants were taken aboard a ship.
changed_reading.after: A sign of preservation achieved by concentrating dispersed posterity into a fully loaded carrier.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The double range of carrying, together with descendants and a filled ship, permits an inward and outward container reading.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same carrying root can describe pregnancy or fruit as well as outward transport. Descendants as dispersible seed are therefore held inside a filled ship that functions analogically as an external gestational vessel.

activation_trace.role: Inward pregnancy and fruit place generative carrying inside the outward act of transport.
Scattering grain makes descendants readable as stored potential for later dispersal.
The ship gives the generative potential an enclosing transport container.
Fullness makes the container fecund and capacity-bearing rather than empty.

changed_reading.before: The passengers are only already-formed descendants.
changed_reading.after: The loaded ship can also image a collective womb or seed-vessel preserving the capacity for descendants.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Divine carrying takes their descendants as a complete load.
baseline_models.mechanism: Carrying can mean assuming an entrusted burden. With posterity as the object and fullness as completed provisioning, the voyage becomes custody of a lineage rather than mere relocation.

activation_trace.role: The trust-and-burden image assigns custodial responsibility to the act of carrying.
The dispersed small collectivity makes lineage itself the entrusted burden.
Completed loading presents the trust as fully taken up and provisioned.

changed_reading.before: Carrying is a neutral change of location.
changed_reading.after: Carrying is the assumption and preservation of an intergenerational trust.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly supplies containment and generation images: a womb gathering pregnancy, seed that grows and bears, human growth, seminal water spanning drop and sea, and the onset of gestation. These cues turn the focus ship's loaded descendants into preserved generative potential at several scales.

activation_trace.role: Pregnancy and fruit provide the focus-side generative hinge.
Scattered grain makes posterity a stored source of later multiplication.
A filled container supplies the holding environment for that potential.
The womb that gathers a pregnancy introduces a collecting-container image at the surah's opening.
A seed that sprouts and itself bears seed supplies compacted future life within the sign sequence.
Human growth and nurture bridge botanical generation to descendants.
Water from drop to sea, including semen, joins the maritime and reproductive scales.
Conception and the growth of pregnancy complete the generation cycle activated around the focus.

structural_cues: 36:33-36 places seed, pairing, and human growth inside the repeated sign sequence that culminates in 36:41.
36:77-79 returns from seminal origin to first gestation and re-creation near the surah's close.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies womb, seed, growth, seminal water, and gestation images; I supply the cross-scale analogy that the ship is an external gestational container. The live alternative is that these are separate creation signs and the focus remains only historical transport.

changed_reading.before: A womb-like ship was only a focus-root possibility.
changed_reading.after: Across the surah, the loaded ship becomes a scale model for preserving generative potential from seed or drop through offspring.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recorded membership and surviving traces are followed later by a deposited covenant addressed to a lineage. These cues sharpen the focus carrying branch of trust: descendants are not only preserved bodies but a living archive through which trace and obligation continue.

activation_trace.role: An entrusted burden provides the focus-side mechanism for transmission.
Posterity supplies the living chain across which the trust can persist.
Entering a name into a register makes preservation include recorded membership.
A remaining mark of what was makes descendants carriers of antecedent trace.
A prior testament deposited for preservation gives the lineage a transmissible obligation.
Filiation and attribution to an origin identify the recipients as an intergenerational chain.

structural_cues: 36:12 joins recording with the traces left behind.
36:60 addresses the children of Adam with an antecedent covenant.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies register, residual trace, deposited testament, and filiation; I infer that descendants transmit what has been entrusted. The alternative is that record and covenant concern accountability independently of the maritime preservation sign.

changed_reading.before: The entrusted load consists only of vulnerable passengers.
changed_reading.after: The descendants are a living archive that carries inherited trace and obligation through the voyage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Generations joined in time are destroyed, all are gathered, and later an emerging lineage is gathered again. Against that sequence, the laden ship acts as a temporary compression chamber: dispersed generations are concentrated for preservation before renewed emergence.

activation_trace.role: Small dispersed posterity supplies the multiplicity that can be compressed and released.
Full loading gives spatial concentration to a temporally dispersed lineage.
People joined within one time period supply the generational units preceding the focus sign.
Gathering dispersed parts into one whole supplies the compression operation.
Separation and rapid emergence reverse the focus vessel's concentration.
The second gathering closes the disperse-concentrate-emerge-regather cycle.

structural_cues: 36:31-32 immediately precedes the repeated sign sequence with destroyed generations and universal gathering.
36:51-53 later moves from graves through emergence to another universal gathering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies generations, gathering, emergence, and regathering; I infer that the loaded ship is a small-scale rehearsal of temporal preservation and concentration. The alternative is that the two gathering scenes are eschatological bookends without modeling the vessel.

changed_reading.before: The ship contains one historical passenger group.
changed_reading.after: The loaded ship can represent generations compressed into a preservable continuity before later dispersal and regathering.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding celestial sequence supplies flow, deliberate measure, orbital falak, and swimming motion. The same falak root then switches to its ship branch in the focus, making preservation a voyage through an ordered course rather than an isolated escape.

activation_trace.role: The maritime branch turns the shared falak root into the descendants' carrier.
Physical carriage makes the ordered course consequential for vulnerable passengers.
Flowing movement supplies continuous directed transit before the focus.
Deliberate planning and measure assign governance to the course.
The celestial orbit branch supplies the ordered circuit that the focus root immediately re-materializes as a ship.
Running and swimming unifies celestial motion with movement through water.

structural_cues: 36:38-41 is an uninterrupted progression from measured celestial motion to the loaded ship.
The exact root ف ل ك occurs in 36:40 and 36:41 with adjacent celestial and maritime branch realizations.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies measured motion, celestial falak, swimming, and then maritime falak; I infer that adjacency transfers ordered-course logic to the ship. The live alternative is a rapid lexical shift whose two senses are juxtaposed without making the voyage cosmic.

changed_reading.before: The ship is a vehicle in an otherwise unspecified rescue journey.
changed_reading.after: The ship carries posterity through a measured course homologous to the ordered trajectories immediately preceding it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation generalizes the ride, exposes it to drowning with no independent rescuer, and then names mercy as the exception that extends use only to a time. Full loading therefore indicates complete dependence under provision, not autonomous security.

activation_trace.role: The successful physical carrying supplies the preserved state that the continuation qualifies.
A fully equipped vessel supplies capacity but not self-sufficient safety.
Riding on a mount extends the focus carrying pattern beyond the named ship.
Literal drowning supplies the failure mode latent beneath maritime carriage.
Extraction from a predicament names the rescue that the passengers cannot secure independently.
Mercy supplies the preserving exception after the threat of drowning.
Extended keeping for use makes survival a granted prolongation.
The appointed time places a temporal boundary around the granted transit.

structural_cues: 36:41-44 forms one sequence: carried descendants, analogous rideables, possible drowning, then mercy and temporary use.
The repeated beneficiary and passenger pronouns keep the threat and exception attached to the people for whom 36:41 is a sign.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ride, drowning, failed rescue, mercy, prolongation, and a time limit; I infer that 36:44 states the condition under which 36:41's carrying succeeds. The alternative is that mercy qualifies only the hypothetical drowning scene and does not revise the earlier ancestral sign.

changed_reading.before: Past successful carrying chiefly demonstrates completed preservation.
changed_reading.after: Successful carriage is a mercy-sustained and time-bounded transit whose full vessel remains wholly dependent.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The specialized sailors' master branch under ر ب ب is surprising and must not be presented as the surface meaning of the divine title. It remains live because signs of their Lord follow the ship sign within five ayat and the focus explicitly attributes the carrying to divine agency; downstream prose should mark this only as a form-distant nautical resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The divine first-person carrying and the named ship support an image of governed rather than anonymous conveyance.

activation_trace.role: Divine physical carriage supplies the agency that can be imagined as navigation.
The literal ship gives the specialized nautical branch a precise focus anchor.
The master of sailors image casts the nearby Lord-sign construction as piloting and provisioning the voyage.

changed_reading.before: The vessel is an impersonal means by which carrying happens.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the ship sign can be heard as a piloted and provisioned passage under its Lord.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: A tar-coated vessel is a remote branch of the sleeping-place root, so this is not a lexical gloss of the grave scene. It remains anchored because that scene moves from graves through emergence to gathering while the focus supplies a loaded ship of descendants; render it only as a speculative death-container and disembarkation analogy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The loaded ship holding descendants can be analogically reversed by the later container, emergence, and gathering sequence.

activation_trace.role: The literal ship supplies the container from which the death-vessel analogy departs.
Fullness lets the container hold a collective lineage across a suspended interval.
Separation and emergence function as a disembarkation from containment.
The tar-coated vessel image makes the sleeping-place branch unexpectedly maritime.
Gathering dispersed persons supplies the collective arrival after emergence.

changed_reading.before: The ship preserves one generation through danger in life.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the loaded vessel can prefigure a container carrying generations through a death-like interval toward collective emergence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The raft image belongs to a non-dominant mapped root under the promise occurrence, making the activation deliberately form-distant. It remains valid because the focus ship, the nearby time limit, and the later promise are all packet-supplied; downstream prose should label it wordplay-like rather than claim that the promise lexeme literally means raft here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ship carrying descendants provides the maritime vehicle for a temporal crossing.

activation_trace.role: The literal ship anchors the proposed crossing image.
A bounded time turns the voyage into a passage toward an endpoint.
The raft that crosses water gives the awaited promise an exploratory ferry image.

changed_reading.before: The vessel crosses only physical water.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it also ferries lineage through a limited present toward the awaited promise.

strongest_changes: The adjacent celestial and maritime branches of ف ل ك recast the voyage as a measured course.
36:42-44 makes the successful transit contingent on mercy and bounded by time.
Generation cues from womb, seed, seminal water, and gestation strengthen the ship as an external carrier of reproductive potential.
Record, trace, covenant, and filiation make the descendants a living archive as well as passengers.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses several mechanisms into one loaded carrier: physical preservation, gestational containment, custodial transmission, and measured motion. The immediate context then removes any implication that fullness or technology guarantees safety, while specialized branch images preserve pilot, death-vessel, and promise-raft resonances as contained outliers.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not settle the precise referential relation between the addressed group and their descendants in the ship.
The cosmic-course reading may be an intended transfer across adjacent senses of ف ل ك or only a deliberate juxtaposition.
The womb, pilot, tarred-vessel, and raft readings depend on cross-domain or form-distant branch activation and should not displace the direct transport reading.
